summary: LFAB1 is a 300 mm fab in Lehi, Utah that Texas Instruments agreed in 2021 to buy from Micron Technology for USD 900 million and re-equipped for analog and embedded processing chips. TI says production began in 2022, about a year after the purchase and earlier than the early-2023 start it had first guided. TI described LFAB1 as still ramping in June 2025 and in its FY2025 annual report, and the new LFAB2 is being built next to it.

notes: The fab was built for memory production by a Micron and Intel venture; the record is in scope because TI re-equipped it and started production there in 2022. The production start is dated only to the year, from the operator's Lehi page. The purchase price is the acquisition consideration, not spending on re-equipping the fab.
